UNLOAD's tombstone convention (\x01<unloaded> above) for the registry slot module_init keeps for a skipped procedure (38a4375a3): a name no lookup finds; the procedure name after the marker is for a reader of the binary and is never split back out -- not an aggregate (ruled by the cfo, census owner, 2026-10-02 on CEO-1444; a typed cure is an inert-slot flag on the registry record, for the tombstone too)

ONE name that holds a NUL byte, or begins with byte 1, spelled as a C-string key: byte 1, then the hex of its bytes (eb92ef197, CEO-1412), so $, the namespace and every capture reach one cell; an injective spelling of a single value, compared whole, never decoded or split, and NV_name_needs_key's first-byte test is the escape that keeps it injective -- not an aggregate (ruled by the cfo, census owner, 2026-10-02 on CEO-1444; a typed cure is a variable table keyed by the counted name)

NV_CELL_FAST_n declining its one-bucket fast path (8dd265f08) for a name that begins with byte 1: that is the CEO-1412 key convention of NV_name_needs_key above, a name resolved through its hex key, tested at byte 0 only; nothing is joined to the name or split from it (cfo, the census's owner, 2026-10-09)

the \x01 namespace byte on the NAME of the Rat and FatRat DATA types, so a SNOBOL4 DATA RAT or an Icon record Rat is never taken for a Raku Rat when the numeric coercions test a DATA value by type name: bookkeeping in the type registry, never a stored value; the value is a typed two-field record (numerator, denominator) on the collected heap and nothing scans it apart (CEO-1349; carried for Lon's judgement, the Rat gate's 72 other-language fixture runs are its witness)

the self-test of rt_sno_name_dl, the asm leaf of SNOBOL4 by-name lookup (326ce40cc): own() mirrors the leaf declining a name that begins with byte 1, the CEO-1412 key convention (NV_name_needs_key and NV_CELL_FAST_n above), and the "\001x" case feeds it one such key; a lead byte compared whole, nothing joined or split (cfo 2026-10-17, row gate-the-delimited-aggregate-ratchet-reads-other-2-over-baseline-0-rtx-sname-test-c-ceo-1807)
